title: Yes-only anytime-goal markets never produce a row
steps: Run tickets/evidence/PNHL-pipeline-script2.ts (first case): three books quote player_goals only as Yes (no No outcome, no point), as anytime-scorer markets normally are.
expected: A Yes-only market is shown at the best Yes price (fair price from consensus where possible), or the app says one-sided markets are not supported.
actual: quotesFromEvent makes a prop quote with prices {over} only. priceMarkets needs both sides for consensus, so Yes gets no fair price (filterFeed no_fair) and the synthetic No side gets no price (no_price). Nothing is shown. Counts: no_price 1, no_fair 1.
suspected_area: packages/core/src/pricing.ts (consensus needs both sides). Guess: depends on whether the real provider sends a No side for player_goals; unverified because demo has no props
